CommissionSubmission.title: CommissionSubmission
CommissionSubmission.description: A Roblox commission application submitted by a player to balo_xio.

submitterUid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the document.

clientEmail.description: The client's Gmail or contact email address.

robloxUsername.description: The client's Roblox username looked up by the Roblox avatar bot.

robloxUserId.description: The client's numeric Roblox user ID as a string.

robloxAvatarUrl.description: The client's Roblox profile headshot URL fetched by the bot.

workType.description: Which Roblox discipline the player needs help with.

currency.description: Payment currency selected by the player.

totalPrice.description: Total price in the selected currency.

projectDetails.description: Detailed description of what the player wants help with in their game.

gameImages.description: Up to 4 game reference screenshots uploaded by the player.

status.description: Inbox workflow status controlled by balo_xio.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the commission was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the commission was last updated.

/commissions/{commissionId}.description: Stores commission applications submitted to balo_xio's private inbox.
